what: Pre-cutover parity gate compares exit codes only
scenario_or_breakage: Issue requires findings equivalent to R0801, not just matching CI pass/fail. Legacy and new runner can both exit 1 while flagging different file pairs (or one reports a cluster the other suppresses via close gating). Gate passes; Makefile swaps; developers chase the wrong duplicates or miss a newly silent cluster.
suggested_fix: Extend the gate to compare normalized cluster signatures (sorted file:line pairs per cluster) or at minimum duplicate-pair counts plus a stable hash of reported paths; still require exit-code equality.
